digest.component_or_area: binding store and bridge fsck repair
propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes the reverse index entry only if the forward entry contains a jira_key, leaving orphaned reverse keys when forward entries lack jira_key or are deleted
Reverse index orphans are reported indefinitely by rebar bridge fsck as store_integrity faults, masking genuine integrity problems and requiring undocumented private API access to repair
unbind() has no self-contained guard protecting against orphaned reverse keys; safety relies on whole-file invariants that can be violated by merge artifacts or out-of-band store mutations
The public API lacks a supported surface to prune orphaned reverse bindings; existing repair of 13 orphaned keys (REB-410–REB-422) required reaching past the public API into BindingStore._data

rebar bridge fsck --repair flag with pre-write guards will atomically delete orphaned reverse entries via unbind() and save(), refusing deletion if non-reverse_missing_forward faults or retired orphan keys exist
